title: Al o dal?
hook: Places get A, people get DA.

rows.en: to a PERSON → da (their office is implied)

rows.it: Vado al salone = vado dal parrucchiere.
rows.en: same errand, two ways: place ↔ person

watch: That’s why trattorias are called “Da Gino” — it means “at Gino’s”. And da also means FROM: vengo dalla stazione — the verb tells you which.

title: A o in? (cities vs countries)
hook: Cities take A, countries and regions take IN.

rows.it: Abito a Milano. Vado a Roma.
Vivo in Italia. Vado in Toscana.
Sono in farmacia / in banca / in ufficio.
rows.en: many everyday places take plain in (no article)

watch: Sono nata a Mumbai — birthplace is a city, so a (never “da Mumbai”).

title: Da = since / for (still going)
hook: DA + time = it started in the past and is STILL true.

rows.en: I’ve been studying for 3 years (and still do)

watch: Exam favourite: “Da quanto tempo sei in Italia?” → “Da due anni.”

title: Di = of / belonging
hook: DI links two nouns: whose it is, or what it’s part of.

rows.it: Di dove sei? — Sono di Mumbai.

title: A = flavours & styles
hook: What flavour? A + article — not in!
watch: “Gelato nel caffè” would put the ice cream inside the coffee ☕ — that’s an affogato, not a flavour!

title: Alle = at (time)
hook: Times take LE, so at + time = alle.

title: In = transport
hook: How do you travel? IN + vehicle, no article.

rows.it: Vado in autobus / in treno / in macchina.

rows.en: on foot is the exception — a piedi!
